description:
X3 Folding ebike is a stylish city ebike, featuring patented easy folding frame with removeable battery. The frame is made of high-strength aluminum with a premium paint finish. This bike is designed for daily mobility and can be easily driven by anyone.

Fully Collapsible: X3 can collapse fully and comes with a convenient carry handle let you bring it with you wherever you go. And save more space for storage. Provided with both good anti-pressure ability and light weight. All this makes it a perfect.

Smooth and Comfortable Ride: the comfort seat is adjustable for many different heights, and can withstand any terrain with front and rear suspension. With its 16” pneumatic tires, your ride will always be smooth and easy.

Powered by 36V 7.5Ah removable battery, 20 mile range. Ride your X3 bike on full throttle to cruise up to 20 miles on a single charge, with paddle assist goes about 32 miles.

Bright LED headlight with built in LCD Display easy monitor your speed and gear anytime. 3 Speed riding mode.

Quick release and removeable battery, purchase extra battery pack get another 20 miles range.

components.description: features hydraulic disc brakes on both tires to ensure you can safely brake to a stop in any riding condition.
